digest.component_or_area: metrics adapters — Claude Code transcript backfill
propositions: An optional isolated adapter must mine Claude Code session transcripts from the local machine to reconstruct environment and integration diagnosis history using error-signature grep and deterministic keyword/regex classification.
The adapter must classify error signatures into exactly five enum values (env_setup, dependency, integration, tooling, none) using a normative pattern-routing table with no LLM call.
Every emitted classified record must carry source=backfill_classified and confidence=classified labels to segregate low-confidence backfilled values from authoritative structural metrics.

The adapter must remain quarantined behind the backfill script and never imported by core metrics modules (registry.py, __init__.py); a unit test must verify the core package does not transitively import claude_transcripts.

Unit and integration tests must verify deterministic classification over fixture JSONL transcripts, output schema compliance, and that backfill_transcripts.py successfully processes transcript directories without LLM calls.
